name: org_graph_rename_unit
description: Rename a unit in the Org Graph, from effective_on (today by default). Only a unit Espalia holds can be renamed here; one an HRIS supplies is renamed in the HRIS. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin, an Org Graph editor or an owner of the unit or a unit above it.

plan_id.description: the plan whose change this applies. Refused unless you may apply that plan's changes

plan_change_id.description: the plan change this applies; needs plan_id

cause_id.description: groups this with the plan's other changes, to change back together; needs plan_id
